rows.observation: tome-cults/data/talents/demented/void.lua:279 says the monolith 'will attempt to daze enemies ... using your spellpower'. The translation drops 'attempt' and renders it as 每半回合对…敌人施加眩晕2回合, which reads as a guaranteed daze. That makes an attempt that saves or immunity can resist sound certain. Restore the qualifier, e.g. 尝试以你的法术强度眩晕…. The source location is unpinned and the envelope gives no checkout location, so the implementation was not checked.

rows.observation: calamity.lua:72 says the effect 'will fade entirely if you break line of sight with your target for more than 2 turns', which means the target stays out of sight for more than 2 consecutive turns. The translation 如果在过去 2 回合里目标消失在你的视线中 means it fades if sight was lost at any moment in the past 2 turns. That changes both the condition and the threshold. Suggested: 若目标脱离你的视线超过 2 回合，所有诅咒都会消退。

rows.observation: fay-willows.lua:491-507, three problems. (1) 'made we wonder as to just how long I was out' means how long the narrator was unconscious; the translation 他们在外面呆了多久 says how long they stayed outside. (2) 'brushed away some cobwebs from a nearby chair and table to eat my fill' became 擦去一些蜘蛛网，吃掉了它们, where 它们 reads as the cobwebs being eaten. Suggested: 然后坐下饱餐一顿. (3) The same 'the commander' switches between 指挥官 and 司令官 throughout the passage; the name should be consistent within the text.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Cults lore/fay-willows.lua:491–507 废弃定居点一节：I brushed away some cobwebs from a nearby chair and table to eat my fill 误作“擦去一些蜘蛛网，吃掉了它们”（变成吃蜘蛛网）。 contextual 同指吃蜘蛛网，另指 how long I was out（昏迷多久）误作“在外面呆了多久”、同一 the commander 在段内“指挥官/司令官”混用，宿主核对属实，一并修复。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。
